summary: Iteration 22 tested three things: the AI prompt that changes with the doctor's specialty, long visits recorded in parts, and the doctor signature reminder. BACKEND (new suite tests/test_specialty_longvisit.py, 12/12 pass; the pdf assertion was fixed to be case-insensitive; regression suites test_async_consult*.py 24/24 pass after one stale assertion was updated). Cardiology: POST /start returns note.specialita='Cardiologia' immediately. When ready, sezioni come back grouped, e.g. anamnesi 'Fattori di rischio cardiovascolare', sintomi 'Dolore toracico'/'Palpitazioni', esame_obiettivo 'Pressione arteriosa'/'Frequenza cardiaca'/'Auscultazione cardiaca'/'ECG', altro 'Accertamenti programmati'. torl, allattamento and svezzamento are empty and no percentiles are computed. The PDF shows 'specialistica · Cardiologia' and the dynamic items, with no TORL, Allattamento or Percentile OMS. PATCH of edited sezioni persists. Pediatrics regression: specialita 'Pediatria', torl filled, the PDF says 'pediatrica specialistica' and includes TORL. With a linked patient the percentiles are computed and the PDF has 'Percentile OMS'. Old notes without specialita still render as pediatric. Audio parts: an empty part returns 400 and 26MB returns 413. A malformed id, an unknown ObjectId or another doctor's part on /start returns 400. Two real Italian mp3 parts went through the ai_step sequence 'Trascrizione parte 1 di 2' -> 'parte 2 di 2' -> 'Compilazione della cartella' and reached ready. The transcript joins both parts in order with '\n'. The consult_jobs entry and both GridFS part files are deleted afterwards. FRONTEND (1920px): the cardiologist editor shows 'Cartella clinica · Cardiologia' and the tabs Anamnesi / Motivo e sintomi / Esame obiettivo / Parametri / Diagnosi e terapia. The Esame obiettivo tab shows a shimmer while processing. Dynamic items render as editable title + textarea in each tab (the indexes are global across tabs, so the EO tab starts at index 3). Editing, deleting (note-sezione-del) and adding (note-sezione-add) all worked, and Salva persisted them; checked via the API and by reopening the visit from /app/visite. Copia includes the dynamic items. The pediatric doctor still sees the classic fields (torl, torace_auscultazione, addome, allattamento, svezzamento, Crescita tab). Long visit with a mocked MediaRecorder/getUserMedia (setInterval sped up): rotation produced 2 parts and the 'Visita lunga · parte 2' label. Stop showed 'Invio parte 1 di 2…' then 'Invio parte 2 di 2…', then made 2 POST /audio-parts calls and POST /start with part_ids=id1,id2 and no audio field. The pill showed '<name> · Trascrizione parte 2 di 2' and '· Compilazione della cartella', and the visit went ready with the joined transcript. Signature reminder (medico@mantmed.it): the banner is visible; the CTA href is /app/impostazioni?sezione=firma and opens the 'Firma per i referti' section; dismiss hides it for the session, including after a reload. note-signature-hint appears under the PDF button in a ready visit; clicking it closes the overlay and navigates to the signature section. After drawing a signature, both the reminder and the hint disappear. The signature was then DELETED again (GET returns image None).

minor.issue: Parts are not marked as consumed. The same part_id can be passed to a second /start while the first job is still processing, and after the first job finishes and deletes the parts, the second job fails. Parts uploaded but never used also stay in GridFS forever, since consult_audio.files has no TTL or cleanup for metadata.kind='part' (an orphan from an aborted upload was found). Fix: claim the parts atomically (set metadata.consultation_id) on /start and add a periodic cleanup for unclaimed parts older than about 1 day.
Reads the whole upload into memory before the 25MB check. That is acceptable, but a streaming size check would be safer.

If one part has no speech (AIJobError) it is skipped silently. Other errors fail the whole visit, so a retry re-transcribes every part from scratch. Optionally store each part's transcript so a retry can resume.

The 'Prescrizione su misura' table is built for mg/kg dosing. For adult drugs (bisoprololo 2,5 mg, aspirina 100 mg) Posologia, Dose, Volume and Durata are all shown as '—'. Show the free-text dose from note/terapia, or hide the mg/kg columns for non-pediatric specialties. Also, sezioni with gruppo 'altro' (e.g. 'Accertamenti programmati') are printed under '03 Esame obiettivo'.

ui_bugs.issue: The cardiologist's Parametri tab still shows the pediatric growth UI: Femmina/Maschio, Età in mesi, Circ. cranica, 'Peso per età / Altezza per età / Circ. cranica per età' percentile tiles ('inserisci la misura') and the WHO LMS footnote. For non-pediatric specialties show only weight, height and BMI, or rename the tab.
The default payment description for the cardiologist is 'Visita pediatrica specialistica' / 'Visita pediatrica · <motivo>'. It should use note.specialita (e.g. 'Visita cardiologica').

A 'altro'-group item is shown in the Diagnosi e terapia tab, but Copia/Stampa text and the PDF put it under ESAME OBIETTIVO, so the grouping is inconsistent. A new item gets the title 'Nuova voce' and is not focused. Minor.

issues: The AI produced items that duplicate the generic fields (Sintomi plus 'Dolore toracico'/'Palpitazioni' with the same text), which makes the PDF repetitive. Consider telling the prompt not to repeat content already in motivo_visita/sintomi.

action_items: Parametri tab for non-pediatric specialties: hide the pediatric percentile/age-in-months/head-circumference UI
Cassa default description: base it on note.specialita instead of the hard-coded 'Visita pediatrica'
Specialist PDF: drug table shows '—' for every mg/kg column with adult fixed doses; place 'altro' sezioni consistently (editor tab vs PDF/Copia section)
Audio parts: claim parts on /start (prevent reuse) and clean up unclaimed GridFS parts
critical_code_review_comments: useRecorder: rotation starts the new MediaRecorder before stopping the old one, so there is no gap; pending promises keep the order and stop() returns the ordered Blob[]. OK. segSec only counts while recording, so pause works.

ConsultationOverlay.process: resumes from uploaded.current.length on retry. OK. Every recording, even a short single-blob one, now goes through /audio-parts + part_ids; the backend uses strict=True when there is one part, so the old behaviour is preserved.
If /start fails with 'Parte audio non trovata' (part expired or reused), the retry loop keeps sending the same stale part_ids forever. Reset uploaded.current on a 400 from /start.
server.py is 1566 lines: consider splitting out the consultation and AI job module.
ai_step is not cleared when the job becomes ready (a stale 'Compilazione della cartella' stays in the DB); the UI only shows it while processing, so this is cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 3 UI issues for non-pediatric specialty

seed_data_creation: None kept. The TEST_ visits from this iteration and the Alice Conti visits created by the regression suites (plus their measurements) were deleted from Mongo, and the orphan GridFS parts were removed. The doctor signature was drawn and then DELETED (image null).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0. tests/test_specialty_longvisit.py makes about 4 LLM calls plus 2 Whisper calls, and test_ped_percentiles uses the first consented seeded patient and cleans up after itself. The other suites (test_async_consult*.py) create visits on the seeded patient Alice Conti and leave measurements behind, so clean them up. For the long-visit UI, mock with add_init_script: replace window.MediaRecorder with a fake whose stop() emits a Blob of /tmp/p1.mp3 or /tmp/p2.mp3 (base64 in /tmp/mock.js), make getUserMedia return AudioContext.createMediaStreamDestination().stream, and patch setInterval(1000) to 4ms so the 600s rotation fires in about 3s. /app/visite cards have no recent-note-<id> testid; click them by patient-name text. Sezioni indexes are global across tabs. About 10 AI consultations were used this iteration.
